meta.title: Learn Quick — Live English & French lessons
meta.description: Learn English or French with verified teachers in live video lessons. Pay with MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money. Practise translation in our free library.

home.title: Speak with confidence in both of Cameroon's languages
home.subtitle: One-to-one video lessons with verified teachers. Book in minutes, pay with Mobile Money, and practise translation between lessons.

1.title: Choose a teacher
1.body: Filter by language, price, availability and specialty. Watch their intro video.

2.title: Book and pay
2.body: Pick a time in your time zone and approve the payment on your phone.

3.title: Learn live
3.body: Join the lesson in your browser. No app to install. Works on mobile data.

home.featuresTitle: Built for learners in Cameroon and beyond

verified.title: Verified teachers
verified.body: Teachers send their ID, certificates and an intro video. Our team reviews every application.

money.title: Mobile Money payments
money.body: Pay in FCFA with MTN MoMo or Orange Money. Your money is held safely until the lesson takes place.

classroom.title: Live classroom
classroom.body: Video, screen sharing, whiteboard and chat. It switches to audio only when the connection is weak.

library.title: Translation library
library.body: Practise English → French and French → English, from A1 to C2, with instant feedback on every answer.

home.teacherBody: Set your own price and hours, teach students across Africa and get paid to your Mobile Money account.

footer.tagline: Live English and French lessons with verified teachers.

about.spokenHint: Add each language you speak and your level. You must speak each language you teach at C1 level or higher.

good: Show your face and shoulders, facing the camera
Be well lit, in colour, and in focus
Show you smiling and looking friendly
bad: Other people or logos in the photo
Phone numbers or text on the image
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

cert.none: I don't have a teaching certificate
cert.noneHint: You can still apply, but you won't get the Certified badge.
cert.name: Certificate name
cert.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Only our review team can see it.

edu.none: I don't have a university degree
edu.noneHint: A degree is not required, but it can earn you the Professional badge.
edu.fileHint: Optional. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Degrees with a diploma are shown as checked.

desc.headlineHint: One sentence shown under your name, {min} to {max} characters.
desc.bioHint: At least {min} characters. Say who you are, how you teach and who you help.
desc.noContact: Don't include phone numbers, emails, links or WhatsApp. Students contact you through Learn Quick.

good: Be filmed horizontally, in good light
Have clear sound and no background noise
Be spoken in the language you teach (both if you teach both)
bad: Slideshows or videos without you on camera
video.hint: MP4, WebM or MOV, up to 100 MB. On a phone you can record it directly.
